# Scrolling controls

Scrollable containers and scroll bars.

(api-gui-forms-scrollablecontrol)=
## ScrollableControl

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/controls/scrollable_control/scrollable_control.hpp>
class ScrollableControl : public Control
```

ScrollableControl owns the retained scrolling state machine: overflow discovery, viewport/display rectangles, two axis policies, wheel/button/track/thumb interaction, pointer capture, semantic virtual scrollbars, scroll events, and child exposure.

Status: stable. WinForms counterpart: `ScrollableControl`.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `explicit ScrollableControl(StableId stable_id)` | Constructs horizontal and vertical ScrollProperties bound to this owner and enables full-drag behavior by default. |
| `bool auto_scroll() const noexcept` | Reports whether child/content extent automatically determines scrollbar availability and ranges. |
| `virtual void set_auto_scroll(bool enabled)` | Toggles automatic overflow discovery and invalidates layout, paint, hit testing, and semantics. |
| `Size auto_scroll_margin() const noexcept` | Returns extra logical extent reserved beyond measured content. |
| `void set_auto_scroll_margin(Size margin)` | Validates finite nonnegative Size or x/y margins, then recomputes overflow and viewport allocation. |
| `void set_auto_scroll_margin(double x, double y)` | Validates finite nonnegative Size or x/y margins, then recomputes overflow and viewport allocation. |
| `Size auto_scroll_min_size() const noexcept` | Returns the caller-authored minimum logical content extent. |
| `void set_auto_scroll_min_size(Size size)` | Validates finite nonnegative dimensions and recomputes the scroll range. |
| `Point auto_scroll_position() const noexcept` | Returns the compatibility projection of position with negative displayed coordinates. |
| `void set_auto_scroll_position(Point position)` | Accepts compatibility coordinates, normalizes their sign, and scrolls to the corresponding retained position. |
| `Point scroll_position() const noexcept` | Returns the nonnegative internal content offset. |
| `Rect display_rectangle() const noexcept override` | Returns the translated content rectangle whose origin reflects the current negative scroll offset. |
| `Rect viewport_rectangle() const noexcept` | Returns the resolved local client viewport after visible scrollbar extents are consumed. |
| `const ScrollProperties& horizontal_scroll() const noexcept` | Returns mutable or const access to the owner-bound horizontal ScrollProperties object. |
| `ScrollProperties& horizontal_scroll() noexcept` | Returns mutable or const access to the owner-bound horizontal ScrollProperties object. |
| `const ScrollProperties& vertical_scroll() const noexcept` | Returns mutable or const access to the owner-bound vertical ScrollProperties object. |
| `ScrollProperties& vertical_scroll() noexcept` | Returns mutable or const access to the owner-bound vertical ScrollProperties object. |
| `bool hscroll() const noexcept` | Reports resolved horizontal scrollbar visibility. |
| `bool vscroll() const noexcept` | Reports resolved vertical scrollbar visibility. |
| `void set_hscroll(bool visible)` | Authors horizontal visibility through the axis model and recomputes the retained scroll layout. |
| `void set_vscroll(bool visible)` | Authors vertical visibility through the axis model and recomputes the retained scroll layout. |
| `bool get_scroll_state(std::uint32_t bit) const noexcept` | Tests one or more documented scroll-state bits without exposing storage. |
| `void set_scroll_state(std::uint32_t bit, bool value)` | Commits documented state bits and rejects unknown masks so state-machine vocabulary remains closed. |
| `Event<ScrollEvent&>& scroll() noexcept` | Returns the event published for requested user/programmatic notifications after position commits. |
| `std::optional<ScrollEvent> last_scroll_event() const noexcept` | Returns the most recently published scroll transition, if any. |
| `std::uint64_t scroll_event_revision() const noexcept` | Returns a monotonic publication revision suitable for low-noise inspection. |
| `ScrollSnapshot scroll_snapshot() const noexcept` | Projects the complete retained viewport, content, position, margins, and both axis states as values. |
| `bool scroll_to(Point position, ScrollEventType type = ScrollEventType::thumb_position, bool notify = false)` | Clamps an absolute position, commits changed axes, optionally publishes typed events, and reports whether anything moved. |
| `bool scroll_by(Point delta, ScrollEventType horizontal_type = ScrollEventType::small_increment, ScrollEventType vertical_type = ScrollEventType::small_increment, bool notify = false)` | Applies a delta through the same clamping/event law while preserving independent horizontal and vertical event reasons. |
| `void scroll_control_into_view(const Control::Ptr& control)` | Validates descendant ownership and computes the minimum bounded motion that exposes the requested child. |
| `void arrange(Rect final_bounds) override` | Runs ordinary child arrangement, discovers effective content extent, resolves interdependent scrollbar visibility, and commits translated child geometry. |
| `void on_pointer(PointerEvent& event) override` | Owns scrollbar hit parts, primary-pointer capture, thumb dragging, line/page buttons, and terminal end-scroll publication. |
| `void on_pointer_bubble(PointerEvent& event) override` | Consumes normalized wheel input from descendants and applies bounded axis increments without duplicating handled events. |
| `std::vector<SemanticNode> semantic_virtual_children() const override` | Exposes active scrollbars as stable semantic range nodes with increment/decrement/set-value actions. |
| `bool on_semantic_child_action(std::string_view stable_id, SemanticAction action, std::string_view value) override` | Parses a scrollbar virtual-child identity and routes supported semantic range actions through the authoritative axis path. |

(api-gui-forms-scrollbar)=
## ScrollBar

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/controls/range_control/scroll_bar/scroll_bar.hpp>
class ScrollBar : public RangeControl
```

ScrollBar specializes RangeControl with independently bounded button/thumb/repeat timing, inspectable part geometry, proportional thumb allocation, drag and track/button interaction, deterministic key behavior, retained auto-repeat, focus cues, and scrollbar semantics.

Status: stable. WinForms counterpart: `ScrollBar`.

- Button, thumb, and repeat timing are independently bounded; part geometry is inspectable; the thumb is allocated proportionally.
- Supports drag, track, and button interaction and deterministic keyboard movement, with the inherited `RangeControl` event ordering.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `explicit ScrollBar(StableId stable_id, Orientation orientation = Orientation::vertical)` | Constructs an orientation-specific range control with scrollbar cursor and repeat state. |
| `double button_extent() const noexcept` | Returns the logical decrement/increment button axis extent. |
| `void set_button_extent(double extent)` | Accepts a finite bounded extent and invalidates geometry and paint. |
| `double minimum_thumb_extent() const noexcept` | Returns the minimum logical draggable thumb extent. |
| `void set_minimum_thumb_extent(double extent)` | Accepts a finite bounded positive extent and invalidates geometry. |
| `FrameInterval initial_repeat_delay() const noexcept` | Returns the delay before a held part first repeats. |
| `void set_initial_repeat_delay(FrameInterval delay)` | Accepts a positive duration for repeat qualification. |
| `FrameInterval repeat_interval() const noexcept` | Returns the positive interval between qualified repeats. |
| `void set_repeat_interval(FrameInterval interval)` | Accepts a positive repeat cadence. |
| `Rect decrement_button_bounds() const noexcept` | Returns the current local geometry of the leading decrement part. |
| `Rect increment_button_bounds() const noexcept` | Returns the current local geometry of the trailing increment part. |
| `Rect track_bounds() const noexcept` | Returns the local axis track between command buttons. |
| `Rect thumb_bounds() const noexcept` | Returns the constrained proportional thumb geometry within the track. |
| `ScrollBarPart part_at(Point local_point) const noexcept` | Classifies a local point as none, decrement button/page, thumb, increment page/button. |
| `Size measure(Size available) override` | Provides orientation-aware desired thickness and two-button axis length. |
| `void on_paint(Painter& painter, Rect local_damage) override` | Records buttons, chevrons, track, pages, thumb, interaction, focus, and disabled states. |
| `void on_pointer(PointerEvent& event) override` | Owns part qualification, capture, thumb dragging, page/line changes, cancellation, and repeat scheduling. |
| `void on_key(KeyEvent& event) override` | Handles arrows, page movement, home, and end through reasoned RangeControl transitions. |
| `void on_focus_changed(bool focused) override` | Commits keyboard focus cues and stops interaction when focus policy requires. |
| `void on_frame(FrameTime now) override` | Executes deadline-based held-part repeats while preserving current pointer qualification. |
| `SemanticDescriptor semantic_descriptor() const override` | Projects a scrollbar role with range, value, orientation, and line/page actions. |
| `bool on_semantic_action(SemanticAction action, std::string_view value) override` | Routes increment, decrement, page, and set-value commands through ordinary constrained state. |

**Protected members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `void on_detached_from_window() noexcept override` |  |

(api-gui-forms-scrollproperties)=
## ScrollProperties

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/controls/scrollable_control/scroll_properties/scroll_properties.hpp>
class ScrollProperties final
```

ScrollProperties is the owner-bound, per-axis state model for enabled/visible state, authored or automatic range increments, clamped position, orientation, and inspectable snapshot projection.

**Members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `bool enabled() const noexcept` | Reports whether user-driven movement is admitted on this axis. |
| `void set_enabled(bool enabled)` | Commits axis availability and routes the change through the owning ScrollableControl's retained invalidation path. |
| `bool visible() const noexcept` | Reports the resolved or explicitly requested scrollbar visibility. |
| `void set_visible(bool visible)` | Sets explicit axis visibility and asks the owner to recompute viewport, geometry, paint, and semantics. |
| `double minimum() const noexcept` | Returns the inclusive authored minimum scroll value. |
| `void set_minimum(double minimum)` | Validates a finite bound, preserves an ordered range, clamps the current position, and notifies the owner atomically. |
| `double maximum() const noexcept` | Returns the inclusive content-range maximum before large-change viewport reduction. |
| `void set_maximum(double maximum)` | Validates a finite bound, preserves an ordered range, clamps the current position, and notifies the owner atomically. |
| `double large_change() const noexcept` | Returns the authored page increment or the automatic viewport-sized increment. |
| `void set_large_change(double value)` | Accepts a finite nonnegative increment, marks it caller-authored, and recomputes axis geometry. |
| `double small_change() const noexcept` | Returns the authored line/wheel increment or the automatic default. |
| `void set_small_change(double value)` | Accepts a finite nonnegative increment, marks it caller-authored, and recomputes axis behavior. |
| `double value() const noexcept` | Returns the committed axis position within the effective maximum-position interval. |
| `void set_value(double value)` | Validates and clamps a requested position, then commits it through the owner's display-rectangle state without synthesizing user input. |
| `ScrollOrientation orientation() const noexcept` | Returns the immutable horizontal or vertical identity assigned by the owner. |
| `ScrollAxisSnapshot snapshot() const noexcept` | Returns a value-only copy of the complete resolved axis state for inspection and tests. |
